programs.desc: Former lecturer Jefferson Grieff (Stanley Tucci) is on death row for murdering his wife.People who need help in criminal matters come to him.One day, a journalist interested in the interview, Beth Davenport (Lydia West), pays him a visit.The reporter has recently met Janice Fife (Dolly Wells).Right after their meeting, she was locked in the basement of vicar Harry Watling (David Tennant).A priest imprisoned his son's tutor to protect him from false accusations of pedophilia.This is how the fates of several people from completely different worlds come together.
